comment: The sound library Carve DAW downloads. scripts/package-library.py turns each entry into a zip plus a UTF-8 README, and writes v1/library.json. Sources are the authors' own distributions, unpacked; nothing in them is changed. Paths starting with ~ are on the machine that packages.

packs.name: 足立レイ
packs.author: みさいる (@missile_39)
packs.description: A UTAU voicebank built from sine-wave synthesis rather than a human voice. Single-sound (CV), Japanese.
packs.licenseSummary: Redistribution and use inside programs are allowed by the author's guideline. Free for doujin (hobby) work, paid or free. Commercial use by a corporation needs the author's permission.
